title: Comparative Study of Reconstituted JUVÉDERM® Ultra vs COSMODERM® 1 for Lip and Cheek Lines, Folds or Wrinkles
brief_summary: This study is being done to evaluate the differences in the performance of two well known injectable dermal fillers commonly used for the cosmetic treatment of age lines above the lips and on the cheeks when compared to each other in the same patient. The products being tested are Juvéderm® Ultra and CosmoDerm® 1.
